intro.headline: 5 hook formulas that work in any niche.

items.title: "I tried / quit / lost..."
items.body: Personal stakes. People stay to see what happened.

items.title: "Most people don't know..."
items.body: A curiosity gap. Implies you have the inside answer.

items.title: "If you're [X], stop doing [Y]."
items.body: Calls out a person. They can't scroll past themselves.

items.title: "Here's the truth about [X]."
items.body: Positions you as the one cutting through the noise.

items.title: "[Number] things I learned about [X]."
items.body: Promises a list. The brain wants to finish it.

intro.headline: 5 things to check before every shoot.
intro.subheadline: Number 4 is the one everyone skips.

items.title: Shoot 4K at 60fps
items.body: The one camera setting that actually matters.

items.title: Test the mic, then play it back
items.body: Don't trust the meter. Listen to 5 seconds.

items.title: Scout your spots
items.body: Switch location every line. This is the skipped one.

items.title: Leave headroom
items.body: Space above your head so the title never covers your face.

items.title: Act 1: The hook
items.body: 0 to 1.5s. State the problem sharp. Stop the thumb.

items.title: Act 2: The tension
items.body: 4 to 12s. Give a reason to keep watching.

items.title: Act 3: The payoff
items.body: 13s+. Deliver, then one clean close. Don't trail off.

items.title: Weak first second
items.body: A slow open kills it before the hook lands.

items.title: Too many ideas
items.body: One video, one point. Cramming means nothing sticks.

items.title: No reason to finish
items.body: If there's no payoff coming, people leave early.

items.title: Inconsistent posting
items.body: The algorithm rewards reliability. Show up.

items.title: No clear next step
items.body: Give one action: follow for more.
